prompts.name: A — Royal Sapphire
prompts.prompt: Create ONE polished concept sample of a redesigned Royal Throne match-3 Color Ball booster. Reference image is the current object: retain its spherical rigid metal volume, three-quarter front camera with top visible, proportions, central horizontal equatorial gold seam separating upper and lower artwork, and flush multicolored mounted jewel details. Redesign surface artwork ONLY; compatible silhouette for existing spin animation. Clean premium stylized 3D mobile game sprite aesthetic, broad readable highlights, strong saturated jewel colors (red green yellow blue violet), clear at one board cell. Object centered, entire sphere visible, occupies 72 percent of square canvas. Plain muted blue-gray background, small soft contact shadow. No animation, beams, VFX, aura, sparks, lettering, labels, crowns protruding, spikes, stand or extra objects. NOT rubber or jelly. Deep royal-blue polished metallic shell, restrained gold rim around each round jewel stud, a refined double gold equatorial seam, a tiny engraved sun motif in an unoccupied metal panel. Emphasize elegant blue/gold royal identity without clutter.
